author: Butter08
quote: Well, rockstar did it. They ruined GTA. They took a perfect thing, and made it slow and unlikable. With tons of bloat content it’s what you expect from a modern game. But the mechanics don't even feel nice. This is not what we’ve come to expect from a rockstar game. It feels slow and is constantly sacrificing player agency for “realism”. Making this not much more than a technical showcase for old hardware. Not to mention the wokeification of the game is demeaning to most of its player base. The music is excellent but that has almost nothing to do with rockstar, any music minded person could whip up some nice radio stations. Funny enough though the shining light of this game is music from bygone era showing better representation of the uncensored human spirit. This game is slop. It did not have to be, and it’s staggering that nobody made a stand against some of the insane decisions made surrounding this game. I think rockstar has finally sold out. Red dead 2 was already this incredibly slow game with no raw edginess that was nothing special without its graphics. The soul of GTA has been forever lost. The soul of rockstar has been left behind. Much like the rest of the entertainment industry today. We are left with cringy millennial slop that’s too full of itself to recognize it is losing the plot. Sad day in gaming, and I would love to see a return to GAMES BEING FUN. I would also like a return to having soul and catering to a raw, uncensored, freedom that we grew to love about GTA. GTA used to have stelar writing and pacing, amazing actors, and a certain level of unhinged nature to it. A lot of this has been tarnished and it feels odd to say. There are some moments in GTA 6, I can’t say it’s all bad, but having its moment isn’t what makes a legendary game. ALL of the previous GTA games are nothing but moments from start to finish, even GTA 4 and 5 having some more bloat kept them engaging a refreshing. GTA 6 really wasted our time moving coffee tables without any player agency to it. It’s an insane choice that feels like rockstar is spitting on its fans. Fun while it lasted guys. I’ll be playing GTA 4 tonight.
